eps.t: A Little Batty/The Clean Up Mix Up
eps.o: Molly thinks she's seen a rare Australian bat; Molly, Tooey, and Trini teach Travis what it really means to take care of the land.

eps.t: Steam Bath Ch'oondaii/In the Dark of Day
eps.o: Molly and Oscar build a traditional steam bath to help Layla recover from a cold so she can take her pilot exam; Oscar thinks he has spotted a snow monster.

eps.t: Meteorite Out of Sight/Not a Mascot
eps.o: Molly and Tooey set out to find a meteorite; Molly, Tooey and Trini try to convince the Sitka basketball team to change its name.

eps.t: A Qyah Juneteenth/The Mystery of the Missing Meat
eps.o: Trini decides to plan a Juneteenth celebration with Molly and Tooey; Molly and Tooey launch an investigation when items mysteriously disappear from the Trading Post.

eps.t: What's Good for the Goose/Whistle Work
eps.o: Molly and Trini need to find a way to relocate a stubborn goose; Mr. Patak's whistle is gone. Can Molly and Tooey replace it before he returns?

eps.t: A Fin Romance/Follow That Hat!
eps.o: Can Molly reunite a baby beluga and their mom? Only with Suki's help!; When Molly's fishing hat floats away, she and Grandpa Nat go on a quest to get it back.

eps.t: Tusk, Tusk, and More Tusk/The Jökulhlaup Is on Us
eps.o: Molly, Tooey, and Trini find a tusk and must figure out how to excavate it!; When a flood threatens to wash away her auntie's cabin, Molly vows to save it.

eps.t: Truth, Trust, and Harvest/Thanks-For-Giving
eps.o: Molly, Trini and Vera are excited to plant the community garden; Molly, Tooey and Trini discover why Grandpa Nat doesn't celebrate Thanksgiving.

eps.t: Caught Off Gourd/Dogsled Special Delivery
eps.o: Molly, Tooey and Trini make pumpkin boats after Trini's giant pumpkin crashes on the ground; Molly and Tooey find a stowaway baby fox in their sled bag.

eps.t: Dinjik Dhah/Message in a Bottle
eps.o: Molly and her friends learn how to tan their own moose hide; Molly and Tooey find a message in a bottle while playing on the riverbank.

eps.t: Light Up the Night/Tracked and Found
eps.o: Trini is determined to learn an ice skating move; Tooey and his brothers use tracking skills to find their dad in the forest.

eps.t: The Off-Trail Tale/Star Eyes
eps.o: Molly and Tooey get lost in the wilderness while gathering firewood; Molly uses a constellation to find her way to Grandpa's friend's cabin.

eps.t: Qyah Counts/You've Gotta Have a Good Mind
eps.o: Molly and her friends hold an election to decide what gift to give Congresswoman Anna Jones; Molly's uncle visits.

eps.t: Mother's Day Mission/Dléit Yéil
eps.o: Molly must find her mom's plane keys so she can get home in time for Mother's Day; Trini spots a talking white bird.

eps.t: Reading the Sky/Salmon in the Smoke
eps.o: Uncle Cliff and Grandpa Nat teach Molly how to read weather signs, a skill she uses when out hunting wild plants with Trini and her dad; Oscar and Molly help Aunties Midge and Merna smoke salmon for an annual contest.

eps.t: Smoky Solutions/Tooey's Egg-Sighting Adventures
eps.o: While her parents are away helping with wildfires, Molly and Vera team up to make sure fire hazards don't exist in Qyah; Tooey invites Molly to collect herring gull eggs with him, but the usual nests are empty--they must find out why.

eps.t: Special Salmon/Love Your Locks
eps.o: Molly wants to make a salmon dish on her cooking show, but Grandpa Nat explains many threats to Alaska's salmon that have made it hard to catch any. Then, Randall is growing out his hair to use on a traditional Tlingit mask that he's gifting to Uncle Jack, but shhh... it's a secret!

eps.t: No T for Me/Catch My Drift
eps.o: Tooey's substitute teacher can't pronounce "Teekone" or "Tooey," so she takes to calling him "T" - a nickname he dislikes. With Grandmother Elizabeth's help, Tooey learns the history of his name and how to ask others to call him by it. Then, Molly and Walter are traveling by boat when suddenly, their engine fails. Can they fix the engine and get home?

eps.t: Halloween Party Panic/The Spruce Sleuths
eps.o: Molly helps Jake, who's non-Native, properly dress up as an Indigenous hero for Halloween./What's causing trees in Qyah to turn rusty brown? Molly is on a mission to find out.

eps.t: Happy Birthday, Qyah!
